The button keeps a single link. If the meeting gets a new link every time, the button stops working. Use a recurring meeting or the organizer\'s personal room (Personal Meeting ID).
If the invite link already includes the passcode (it ends in \"?pwd=…\"), you don\'t need to type it. If you do type one, that one is used.
The display name may not be used
If the person is signed in to a Zoom account, Zoom shows that account\'s name instead of the one typed here. Zoom decides this, not this app.
Zoom must be installed on the phone. If it isn\'t, ConnectMe says so and shows an \"Install Zoom\" button.

resources.string: Removing the button from the home screen

Android doesn\'t let the app remove the button by itself. Touch and hold the button on the home screen and choose Remove. If you delete the meeting or untick \"Add a big button on the phone\'s home screen\", the button turns gray and says \"Tap to choose a meeting\".
Meetings move to the new phone if Google backup or Android\'s data transfer is used. Otherwise they need to be set up again. The home-screen button may also need to be added again.
